$comment: THE STAGE REGISTRY — what a DEFER marker is allowed to name.
`scripts/docs.test.mjs` reads this file. A DEFER naming a stage that is not
here fails; a DEFER naming a stage whose status is `shipped` fails.
⚠️ THAT SECOND RULE IS THE WHOLE MECHANISM. Flipping a stage to `shipped`
is what forces every deferral pointing at it to be done, re-targeted with a
reason, or deleted on purpose. A stage cannot be declared finished while
something still expects work from it — which is exactly the failure that
made this registry necessary: a sentence in a document survives a
compressed conversation, and the intent behind it does not.
Stages mirror docs/ONE-PLATFORM.md §8. Keep the ids stable — a marker in a
file elsewhere in the repo names one of them.

stages.title: Kernel — bindings, identity, tenancy, regions, standing
Surface — operations to routes, tools, webhooks, OpenAPI
Data — collections, ledger, files, jobs, relocation
Renderer — shell, nav, collection views, whitelabel, PWA
Commerce — plans, entitlements, flags, Stripe, metering
Ops — notifications, help, versioning, data centre, CI
